title: Transfinite Schreier families and cardinal invariants
summary: We study the dependence of the transfinite Schreier hierarchy on the choice of fundamental sequences for the countable limit ordinals. With each Schreier family we associate an interval endpoint function. We prove that the bounding number is equal to $ω_1$ exactly when the fundamental sequences may be chosen so that these endpoint functions form an unbounded family in the eventual domination order. Equivalently, the hierarchy then satisfies the tail-covering property isolated by Shiliaev, or every infinite compact interval family has infinite intersection with some member of the hierarchy.…
